item.title: Abu Dhabi to Host Major Global Live Entertainment Summit in 2026
item.description: The global live entertainment industry is gearing up for a major change in its international calendar. item.title: Saudi Arabia Revises Labour Penalties, Sets SR10,000 Fine For Hiring Foreign Workers Without Permits
item.description: Saudi Arabia has amended its schedule of labour violations and penalties, introducing updated fines including a SR10,000 penalty for employing a non-Saudi worker without a valid work permit. item.title: Bahrain: Heritage Village Evenings Are Back This Ramadan
item.description: The Ministry of Information is bringing the magic of Heritage Village Evenings back this Ramadan with the festival’s second edition in 2026. item.title: Bahrain: Luxury Car Fraud Attempt Ends in Jail, Fine, And Deportation
item.description: The First High Criminal Court of Appeal has upheld a three-year prison sentence against an Arab defendant who attempted to buy a BMW 320 valued at BD 25,000 using bank cards that did not belong to him. item.title: Bahrain: Fake Police Officers Rob Garage In Salmabad
item.description: The High Criminal Court of Appeal confirmed a five-year prison sentence for five men involved in a violent robbery at a Salmabad garage. item.title: Saudi Arabia: Temperatures To Drop To 0°C In Northern Regions, NCM Warns
item.description: The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has forecast a drop in temperatures across several northern regions of the Kingdom, with near-subzero readings expected from Feb. 18 to Mar. 1. The forecast is based on the NCM’s animated weather map outlining areas affected by the temperature decline. According to the center, the cold wave is expected to hit on Saturday and Sunday, impacting most northern parts of the Kingdom.
